svg.title: Dark Blue with White Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-recent-painting-and-sculpture-05-2003/lightbox/works/dark-blue-with-white-relief-2002-18625; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
